title: Lollipop with a smiling face
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- stick -->
  <rect x="46" y="52" width="8" height="38" rx="4" fill="#F5C27A"/>
  <rect x="47" y="52" width="3" height="38" rx="1.5" fill="#FFE2B0"/>
  <!-- lollipop head -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="28" fill="#FF4F8B"/>
  <!-- spiral swirl -->
  <path d="M50 38 m0 -20 a20 20 0 1 1 -0.01 0" fill="none" stroke="#FFD1E0" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 38 m0 -13 a13 13 0 1 1 -0.01 0" fill="none" stroke="#FF7FAE" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <path d="M50 38 m0 -6 a6 6 0 1 1 -0.01 0" fill="none" stroke="#FFD1E0" stroke-width="5" stroke-linecap="round"/>
  <!-- highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="38" cy="27" rx="7" ry="4" fill="#FFE6F0" opacity="0.8" transform="rotate(-30 38 27)"/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <ellipse cx="40" cy="34" rx="3.5" ry="4.5" fill="#3B1E5E"/>
  <ellipse cx="60" cy="34" rx="3.5" ry="4.5" fill="#3B1E5E"/>
  <circle cx="41.5" cy="32.5" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <circle cx="61.5" cy="32.5" r="1.4" fill="#FFFFFF"/>
  <!-- blush -->
  <ellipse cx="31" cy="42" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FF8FB8" opacity="0.9"/>
  <ellipse cx="69" cy="42" rx="5" ry="3" fill="#FF8FB8" opacity="0.9"/>
  <!-- smile -->
  <path d="M41 46 Q50 55 59 46" fill="none" stroke="#3B1E5E" stroke-width="3" stroke-linecap="round"/>
</svg>
